questions.stem_text:
The dominant course for foreign policy throughout most of American history can be
categorized as
What did Paul Kennedy argue in his book The Rise and Fall of the Great Powers?

options.A: All of the world's leading economies were declining due to low growth and inflation
options.B: The United States could no longer remain a superpower and was in decline
options.C: The soft power of the United States would allow it to avoid decline
options.D: The rise of Japan had been exaggerated

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - The United States could no longer remain a superpower and was in decline
